{"dialogue": "Devon: you just get home?
Me: yeah like 10 mins ago, still in work clothes lol
Devon: same, nuggets last night gave me heartburn so doing toast tonight
Me: oh nooo fancy toast at least?
Devon: peanut butter fancy
Me: elite
Devon: 5th was still a mess btw
Me: ugh by the bank again?
Devon: yep cones everywhere still
Me: i thought they'd be done by now honestly
Devon: for real, took me forever to get through
Me: cat is already on my clean laundry again
Devon: of course she is, it's tradition at this point
Me: literally only the clean load, never dirty
Devon: same with mine, zero chill
Me: did your boss actually stay out today?
Devon: yeah no last minute chart hell thank god
Me: nice, mine tried to get me to stay late and i was like nope
Devon: good for you, you work too many late nights
Me: fr, i'm beat
Devon: hey so for friday, can we push it from 6 to 7?
Me: oh yeah 7 works for me, still heading straight from work anyway
Devon: perfect thanks, got stuck with something till like 6:30
Me: no worries, still Mario's right?
Devon: yep Mario's on Pine still, just later
Me: cool, craving that cheesy stuff anyway
Devon: same, Rosa's was good but i want heavy slices this time
Me: exactly, thin crust didn't fill me up last time
Devon: coworker said the pepperoni there is huge
Me: oh good to know, i'll probably get that
Devon: mom asked about you again btw
Me: aww tell her i said hi
Devon: she still thinks about you demolishing that potato salad lol
Me: tell her i still think about it too, it was that good
Devon: hahaha i will, she said she'll make extra next time
Me: okay now i have to come to the next lunch
Devon: she'll hold you to that
Me: you do groceries with her again this weekend?
Devon: nah last weekend was enough, fridge is still stocked
Me: nice, i need to go, i have like no snacks
Devon: go tomorrow after work? before friday i mean
Me: yeah probably, otherwise i'll just eat croutons lol
Devon: been there, did you ever freeze more of that lemon pepper chicken?
Me: yeah still have some, might do that tomorrow
Devon: smart, better than my toast era
Me: hey toast era is valid
Devon: lol true, okay so friday 7 then?
Me: yep see you there
Devon: i'll text when i'm leaving work
